name: Broken Knuckles
summary: Eggrobo and Mecha Sonic have delivered a chain letter to Knuckles. It contained the following message: "Send this letter to ten friends of yours, otherwise you'll be paralised and won't be able to walk left or right". Since Knuckles doesn't have this much friends, he (in his desire to restore his normal walking abilities) goes on an adventure to kick their robotic butts.
